sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 在太空的七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星星的背后有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千个消费产品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60个超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最好的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用一个不同的起始单词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 而且我很喜欢一个锅的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来帮助您理解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅以获取优惠，网址为 nytimes.com 加上 subscribe。

sentences.en: So I was in class.
sentences.zh: 当时我正在上课。

sentences.en: I was about to turn in all my work to the teacher.
sentences.zh: 我正准备把所有的作业交给我老师。

sentences.en: So I was already starting to pack up my things slowly.
sentences.zh: 所以我已经开始慢慢收拾我的东西了。

sentences.en: And I got a call from my mom.
sentences.zh: 然后我接到了我妈妈的电话。

sentences.en: She seemed very down.
sentences.zh: 她显得非常沮丧。

sentences.en: And she was like, it's like when you hear somebody, they're trying not to cry.
sentences.zh: 她的语气，就像你听到有人在极力忍住不哭一样。

sentences.en: But like, they're really like holding it in.
sentences.zh: 但又像是，她们真的在强忍着。

sentences.en: And I could hear in her voice.
sentences.zh: 我能从她的声音里听出来。

sentences.en: And that's when I started to get a little bit worried.
sentences.zh: 然后我开始有点担心了。

sentences.en: She told me that like, your father got detained.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，你的父亲被拘留了。

sentences.en: And then that's when it was just like, it felt like somebody put a little like 10,000 blocks of like bricks on my cheSt.
sentences.zh: 然后那种感觉就像，仿佛有人把一万块砖头压在了我的胸口。

sentences.en: I was just hearing mumbles.
sentences.zh: 我只能听到一片含糊不清的话。

sentences.en: I felt like I was building up so many emotions and it was all going to come out.
sentences.zh: 我感觉自己积压了太多的情绪，马上就要全部爆发出来了。

sentences.en: And I didn't want anybody to see me like that.
sentences.zh: 我不想让任何人看到我那个样子。

sentences.en: So I just gave my paper to my teacher and I like ran out of the classroom and I tried to get in my car as fast as possible.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是把试卷交给了老师，然后跑出了教室，尽量以最快速度钻进我的车里。

sentences.en: And it's just like, you just start envisioning the worSt.
sentences.zh: 那种感觉就是，你会开始设想最坏的情况。

sentences.en: Like, he's in this terrible place.
sentences.zh: 比如，他在某个可怕的地方。

sentences.en: This is a hardworking man.
sentences.zh: 这是一个努力工作的男人。

sentences.en: No criminal record.
sentences.zh: 没有犯罪记录。

sentences.en: Like, you guys just took him.
sentences.zh: 就像是，你们竟然直接把他抓走了。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: In his first 100 days, President Trump has struggled to fulfill his promise of deporting
sentences.zh: 在上任的前100天里，特朗普总统一直在艰难地兑现驱逐承诺

sentences.en: one million undocumented immigrants, a reality that has prompted his administration to change its strategy.
sentences.zh: 即驱逐一百万无证移民，这一现实促使他的政府改变了策略。

sentences.en: Rather than putting its focus on migrants with a criminal record or those who recently crossed
sentences.zh: 白宫不再将重点放在有犯罪记录的移民或最近过境的移民身上

sentences.en: the border, the White House is increasingly seeking to deport those who came to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而是越来越寻求驱逐那些几十年前来到美国

sentences.en: decades ago and have established a life, career, and family in America.
sentences.zh: 并在美国建立生活、事业和家庭的人。

sentences.en: Today, Daily producer Jessica Chung tells the story of one such migrant through the eyes of his daughter.
sentences.zh: 今天，《每日新闻》制作人杰西卡·钟通过他女儿的视角，讲述了这样一个移民的故事。

sentences.en: It's Friday, May 2nd.
sentences.zh: 今天是5月2日，星期五。

sentences.en: I first spoke to Isla back in February.
sentences.zh: 我最早是在2月份和艾拉交谈的。

sentences.en: This was a month into the Trump administration, which had promised quick and mass deportations.
sentences.zh: 当时正值特朗普政府上台一个月，该政府曾承诺进行迅速的大规模驱逐。

sentences.en: I was calling immigration lawyers around the country, trying to get a sense of who exactly was getting targeted for deportation and how ICE was finding them.
sentences.zh: 我当时在给全国各地的移民律师打电话，试图弄清楚究竟谁成了驱逐的目标，以及移民及海关执法局是如何找到他们的。

sentences.en: And that's when a lawyer called me back, saying you got to talk to Isla.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，一位律师回了我的电话，说你得和艾拉聊聊。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: So this is Jessica.
sentences.zh: 这是杰西卡。

sentences.en: This is Ayla.
sentences.zh: 这是艾拉。

sentences.en: She's Fabricio's 20-year-old daughter.
sentences.zh: 她是法布里西奥20岁的女儿。

sentences.en: Okay, great.
sentences.zh: 好的，太好了。

sentences.en: Nice to meet you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴认识你。

sentences.en: Nice to meet you, too.
sentences.zh: 我也很高兴认识你。

sentences.en: My name is Isla Gomez.
sentences.zh: 我叫艾拉·戈麦斯。

sentences.en: The first thing that struck me about Isla Gomez was her bubbly personality.
sentences.zh: 艾拉·戈麦斯给我留下的第一印象是她那生动活泼的性格。

sentences.en: She's excitable.
sentences.zh: 她很容易兴奋。

sentences.en: So positive.
sentences.zh: 非常积极乐观。

sentences.en: Oh, Massachusetts.
sentences.zh: 哦，马萨诸塞州。

sentences.en: Right now, Isla's a sophomore at Wentworth Institute of Technology in Massachusetts, where she's studying architecture and interior design.
sentences.zh: 目前，艾拉是马萨诸塞州温特沃斯理工学院的二年级学生，在那里她学习建筑和室内设计。

sentences.en: She was raised in a town called Saugus, just outside Boston.
sentences.zh: 她在波士顿郊外一个叫索格斯的镇上长大。

sentences.en: Where days before we had talked, her dad was detained by ICE officers.
sentences.zh: 就在我们交谈几天前，她的父亲在那里被移民及海关执法局的官员拘留了。

sentences.en: Tell me a little bit about your dad.
sentences.zh: 跟我多讲讲你爸爸吧。

sentences.en: What is his name, how old is he, and what does he do?
sentences.zh: 他叫什么名字，多大年纪，是做什么工作的？

sentences.en: My dad, he's Fabricio Gomez.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸，他叫法布里西奥·戈麦斯。

sentences.en: He is 47 years old, and he works at a construction company of his own.
sentences.zh: 他47岁，经营着自己的建筑公司。

sentences.en: Isla told me in 2001, her dad had settled here in Massachusetts as an undocumented immigrant.
sentences.zh: 艾拉告诉我，2001年，她爸爸作为无证移民在马萨诸塞州安顿下来。

sentences.en: He'd come here from Brazil.
sentences.zh: 他从巴西来到这里。

sentences.en: This was three years before Isla was born.
sentences.zh: 这在艾拉出生前三年。

sentences.en: Tell me about why he left Brazil.
sentences.zh: 跟我讲讲他为什么要离开巴西吧。

sentences.en: Sorry, I'm just asking, like, these questions from my mom, because I never really went, like, in-depth of.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，我只是在问我妈妈这些问题，因为我从来没有真正深入了解过。

sentences.en: So, my mom said it was due to the violence down there, and, like, he couldn't make a living for himself, let alone have a family down there.
sentences.zh: 所以，我妈妈说是因为那里的暴力活动，而且他自己都难以糊口，更不用说在那里养家糊口了。

sentences.en: When he first got here, he lived with his aunt, who was already here.
sentences.zh: 他刚到这里时，和已经在这里的姑姑住在一起。

sentences.en: But eventually, he met Isla's mom, who was also from Brazil.
sentences.zh: 但后来，他遇到了艾拉的妈妈，她也是巴西人。

sentences.en: They actually walked into each other, and they were like, oh, my God, like, I remember you, blah, blah, blah.
sentences.zh: 他们其实是不期而遇，然后他们就说，哦天哪，我记得你，等等等等。

sentences.en: And they moved out on their own, with money Fabricio made by working in construction.
sentences.zh: 他们靠法布里西奥做建筑工赚来的钱搬出去单过。

sentences.en: So, he had been working, like, small jobs, almost like a handyman.
sentences.zh: 所以，他之前一直在做零工，有点像杂工。

sentences.en: And then he met somebody, which is my dad's old boss that still remains in our life, Ken.
sentences.zh: 然后他遇到了一个人，也就是我爸爸的老板肯，至今他仍在我们生活中。

sentences.en: And he slowly taught my dad how to work.
sentences.zh: 他慢慢教我爸爸如何干活。

sentences.en: It went from, like, changing door panels, windows, to fixing inside the house.
sentences.zh: 从更换门板、窗户，到修复房屋内部。

sentences.en: And then it went to roofing, until he gathered up all his knowledge that he had.
sentences.zh: 然后到做屋顶，直到他掌握了所有的知识。

sentences.en: And then that's when he decided that he was ready to open his company and start creating a life for himself and our family.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，他决定自己已经准备好开办公司，开始为自己和我们的家庭创造生活。

sentences.en: And is your sense that he loves his job?
sentences.zh: 你觉得他热爱他的工作吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: My dad is actually very passionate for his job.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸其实对他的工作充满热情。

sentences.en: You would think he wouldn't be, because you're constantly going up a ladder.
sentences.zh: 你可能会觉得不会，因为你得经常爬梯子。

sentences.en: It's so cold, since we live in Massachusetts.
sentences.zh: 而且因为我们住在马萨诸塞州，天气非常冷。

sentences.en: And it's really a hard job.
sentences.zh: 这真的是一份辛苦的工作。

sentences.en: Even though he wasn't fluent in English, he had this way of connecting with people.
sentences.zh: 尽管他的英语不够流利，但他有一种与人沟通的方式。

sentences.en: My dad, wherever he walks, he talks out loud to everybody.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸无论走到哪里，都会大声和每个人说话。

sentences.en: And he talks to people like he knows people.
sentences.zh: 他跟人说话的样子就像他本来就认识对方一样。

sentences.en: He's always talked to his clients like he knew them for so long.
sentences.zh: 他跟客户说话总是像认识了很久一样。

sentences.en: I don't know how he talks to them like everybody understands him.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他是怎么做到跟人说话时人人都听得懂他的。

sentences.en: For as long as she can remember, Isla's wanted to be just like him.
sentences.zh: 在艾拉记事起，她就一直想成为像他一样的人。

sentences.en: As a little kid, I was like, my dad's, like, kind of tomboy.
sentences.zh: 小时候，我就像我爸爸那样，有点像假小子。

sentences.en: Like, I'd always buy construction little kids kit.
sentences.zh: 我总是买儿童建筑玩具套装。

sentences.en: And I would always go around the house with, like, plastic toys.
sentences.zh: 我总是拿着塑料玩具在屋子里转悠。

sentences.en: Me and my dad are the type of person where we take something that is not good and we reform it to make it into a better place.
sentences.zh: 我和我爸爸是一类人，我们会把不好的东西改造得更好。

sentences.en: When something's not designed properly, it doesn't feel that good, like, walking to a house that is just, like, simple.
sentences.zh: 当某个东西设计不合理时，感觉就不太好，比如走进一栋很简陋的房子。

sentences.en: There's no design.
sentences.zh: 没有任何设计。

sentences.en: It just feels down.
sentences.zh: 感觉很压抑。

sentences.en: And when you reform it, it brings another life.
sentences.zh: 而当你改造它之后，它就焕发了新生。

sentences.en: It sounds like you and your dad shared a special bond over your love of building things.
sentences.zh: 听起来你和你爸爸因为都热爱建造东西而有着特殊的纽带。

sentences.en: So, I wonder if you have, like, an early memory of him sharing that love of construction with you.
sentences.zh: 所以我想知道你是否有关于他与你分享这种对建筑热爱的早期记忆。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 有的。

sentences.en: So, this was a fifth grade science fair.
sentences.zh: 那是五年级的科学展览。

sentences.en: First, I had to do kind of, like, the blueprint.
sentences.zh: 首先，我得做类似于蓝图的东西。

sentences.en: So, I went to my cousin and we drew, like, the measurements and everything.
sentences.zh: 所以我去找我表哥，我们画了尺寸和所有东西。

sentences.en: And then I went to my dad.
sentences.zh: 然后我去找我爸爸。

sentences.en: It was for a ramp to, like, define gravity.
sentences.zh: 那是一个用来验证重力的坡道。

sentences.en: If we were to drop something, it would fall, like, on the ramp and it would flip up.
sentences.zh: 如果我们把什么东西扔下去，它会掉到坡道上然后弹起来。

sentences.en: So, my dad took me, one of my favorite stores, it's Lowe's and Home Depot.
sentences.zh: 于是我爸爸带我去了我最喜欢的商店之一，劳氏和家得宝。

sentences.en: And, you know, that's my dad's automatic favorite store because he always has to be there.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，那绝对是我爸爸最喜欢的商店，因为他总是得去那里。

sentences.en: And we had to buy wood, nails, and we had to use, like, the saw because the corners had to connect.
sentences.zh: 我们不得不买木头、钉子，还得用锯子，因为边角必须对接。

sentences.en: So, we had to cut it diagonally to connect.
sentences.zh: 所以我们必须斜着切才能对接。

sentences.en: So, he taught me, like, measurements, too.
sentences.zh: 因此他也教了我测量方法。

sentences.en: I got to do this with my dad.
sentences.zh: 我和爸爸一起完成了这个。

sentences.en: I was able to present it to my class.
sentences.zh: 我把它展示给了我的班级。

sentences.en: I was able to show it to my teachers.
sentences.zh: 我把它展示给了我的老师。

sentences.en: And I got so congratulated for it at school that it's just, like, oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 我在学校得到了很多的祝贺，当时的感觉就是，天哪。

sentences.en: Everybody's going to know me.
sentences.zh: 所有人都会认识我。

sentences.en: Everybody's going to know my dad.
sentences.zh: 所有人都会认识我爸爸。

sentences.en: I'd be, like, do you know my dad does construction?
sentences.zh: 我会说，你知道我爸爸是搞建筑的吗？

sentences.en: He can build your house.
sentences.zh: 他可以给你盖房子。

sentences.en: And I'd offer, like, he could do things for you.
sentences.zh: 我还会主动提出，他可以为你做点什么。

sentences.en: He could build your house.
sentences.zh: 他可以给你盖房子。

sentences.en: I would actually walk around with my parents' card in my purse offering everybody.
sentences.zh: 我甚至会把父母的名片放在钱包里到处走，向所有人推销。

sentences.en: I always wanted to work with my dad.
sentences.zh: 我一直想和我爸爸一起工作。

sentences.en: I'm not going to be able to, you know, carry all the shingles, the roofs, and everything that he does.
sentences.zh: 我可能搬不动所有的瓦片、屋顶材料以及他做的那些重活。

sentences.en: But I'm going to, like, do what my dad does.
sentences.zh: 但我会去做我爸爸做的事。

sentences.en: Which is why I went to college for architecture and interior design.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我上大学学的是建筑和室内设计。

sentences.en: So, eventually, in the future, I could work with my dad's company.
sentences.zh: 这样将来我就可以加入我爸爸的公司工作了。

sentences.en: Ila says her dream is that her dad's company becomes a family company with her.
sentences.zh: 艾拉说她的梦想是让她爸爸的公司成为一个有她参与的家族企业。

sentences.en: His dream was always for us to go to college and pursue something that we have passion for because they weren't able to choose their own path.
sentences.zh: 他的梦想一直是让我们上大学，去追求我们真正热爱的事业，因为他们当年无法选择自己的道路。

sentences.en: Like, you're not born saying, I'm going to clean toilets.
sentences.zh: 就像，你出生时不是说，我要去擦马桶。

sentences.en: I'm going to be a contractor.
sentences.zh: 我要当个包工头。

sentences.en: You're born thinking, like, I want to be a businesswoman.
sentences.zh: 你出生时的想法是，我想成为一名女商人。

sentences.en: I want to go after this.
sentences.zh: 我想去追求这个。

sentences.en: I want to have my own company.
sentences.zh: 我想拥有自己的公司。

sentences.en: I want to have my own home.
sentences.zh: 我想拥有自己的房子。

sentences.en: And it's just, like, I feel like that's what their main goal for us was, that we're able to choose our own path.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这就是他们对我们的主要目标，让我们能够选择自己的路。

sentences.en: My dad, he's always been the person to tell us, work hard.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸，他一直告诉我们，要努力工作。

sentences.en: Nothing's gifted.
sentences.zh: 没有什么东西是凭空送给你的。

sentences.en: Nothing's handed.
sentences.zh: 没有什么东西是唾手可得的。

sentences.en: Go after it.
sentences.zh: 去追求它吧。

sentences.en: So, fast forward to today, the dream that you described your dad having for you guys was in progress.
sentences.zh: 所以快进到今天，你描述的你爸爸对你们的期望正在一步步实现。

sentences.en: Like, you're in college.
sentences.zh: 比如你在上大学。

sentences.en: Your dad is working hard at a business that he owns.
sentences.zh: 你爸爸在他自己拥有的企业里努力工作。

sentences.en: When Trump was inaugurated on January 20th, did your family have conversations about what precautions you guys would take,
sentences.zh: 当特朗普于1月20日就职时，你们家人有没有讨论过你们会采取什么预防措施，

sentences.en: given that he was aggressively pursuing people without documentation?
sentences.zh: 鉴于他一直在大力追捕无证移民？

sentences.en: I would always ask my dad, like, should we worry?
sentences.zh: 我总是问我爸爸，比如，我们该担心吗？

sentences.en: And he'd always tell us, like, no.
sentences.zh: 而他总是告诉我们，别担心。

sentences.en: Like, there's, don't worry.
sentences.zh: 就好像，有，别担心。

sentences.en: As much as, obviously, when I'm alone, when anybody's alone, you always have that thought in the back of your mind.
sentences.zh: 尽管很明显，当我独处时，当任何人独处时，你的脑海深处总会有那种想法。

sentences.en: Like, what am I going to do?
sentences.zh: 比如，我该怎么办？

sentences.en: What if things go down?
sentences.zh: 如果事情发生了怎么办？

sentences.en: What, like, obviously, we worry at all times.
sentences.zh: 什么，就像，很明显，我们无时无刻不在担心。

sentences.en: But I try not to, because if my dad himself could be positive through something like this, and always tell us that, don't worry.
sentences.zh: 但我尽量不去想，因为如果我爸爸自己能在这种事情中保持积极，并且总是告诉我们别担心。

sentences.en: Like, things are always going to get better.
sentences.zh: 就像，事情总会好起来的。

sentences.en: I'm not going to stay here in panic.
sentences.zh: 我不会坐在这里惊慌失措。

sentences.en: Fabricio had no criminal record.
sentences.zh: 法布里西奥没有犯罪记录。

sentences.en: And he didn't want to hide from law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 他也不想躲避执法部门。

sentences.en: He wanted to do things the right way.
sentences.zh: 他想用正确的方式做事。

sentences.en: He's had a pending application for a visa.
sentences.zh: 他有一个待批的签证申请。

sentences.en: In the meantime, he's been checking in with ICE.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，他一直在向移民及海关执法局报到。

sentences.en: He's been doing that for 12 years.
sentences.zh: 他已经这样做12年了。

sentences.en: In February, just one month after Trump's inauguration, he was due for another check-in.
sentences.zh: 在2月份，就在特朗普就职一个月后，他又到了报到的时间。

sentences.en: We were all kind of, like, trying our best to treat it like a regular day.
sentences.zh: 我们大家都有点像，竭尽全力把它当作普通的一天来对待。

sentences.en: Like, he literally called his clients, spoke to them that morning, said that after his court,
sentences.zh: 就像，他那天早上真的给他的客户打过电话，跟他们谈过，说等他开完庭后，

sentences.en: he's going to go to work, and he's going to fix so-and-so's roof, and do this and that.
sentences.zh: 他要去工作，要修某某的屋顶，做这做那。

sentences.en: So, he just shows up for his yearly check-in, and you go there, you represent yourself, talk about whatever is being asked, and that was about it.
sentences.zh: 所以，他只是去进行一年一度的报到，你去了那里，代表你自己，谈论任何被问到的事情，差不多就是这样。

sentences.en: And so her dad shows up to his check-in, like he always does.
sentences.zh: 所以她的爸爸去报到了，就像他一直以来做的那样。

sentences.en: And it was soon after that, that her mom called her in class, notifying Isla that her dad had been detained.
sentences.zh: 就在那之后不久，她妈妈在课上打电话给她，通知艾拉她爸爸被拘留了。

sentences.en: After it was hyperventilating, I felt like my heart just left my cheSt.
sentences.zh: 在那之后我一直在喘不上气，我感觉我的心好像离开了我的胸膛。

sentences.en: I think about him being there.
sentences.zh: 我一想到他在那里。

sentences.en: I think about him being in this close-up space.
sentences.zh: 我一想到他在这个狭小的空间里。

sentences.en: So, I worry a lot at night.
sentences.zh: 所以，我晚上很担心。

sentences.en: Like, what if he's panicking and we don't know?
sentences.zh: 比如，如果他惊慌失措而我们不知道呢？

sentences.en: What if he's holding strong, but he's actually having the hardest time of his life?
sentences.zh: 如果他表现得很坚强，但实际上正经历着他一生中最艰难的时刻呢？

sentences.en: Like, that's what constantly replays in my head.
sentences.zh: 就像，这就是在我脑海中不断回放的画面。

sentences.en: So, it just felt like my whole heart got ripped out of my chest, because I never got to really say a proper goodbye, like, I'll see you later.
sentences.zh: 所以，这感觉就像我的整个心被从胸膛里生生扯了出来，因为我从来没有真正好好道过别，比如，我回头见。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games, and I love horror movies, I love my dog, and I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我编写《连线》这款游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏中的谜题之一，我喜欢恐怖电影，喜欢我的狗，还喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天都创作《拼字蜂》和《字母连线》这两款游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时会看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像你刚才听到声音的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问nytimes.com斜杠games，今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: Isla's dad was detained on February 26.
sentences.zh: 艾拉的爸爸于2月26日被拘留。

sentences.en: He was taken to the Plymouth County Correctional Facility, about an hour's drive away from their home.
sentences.zh: 他被带到了普利茅斯县惩教所，距离他们的家大约有一小时的车程。

sentences.en: Eventually, Isla was able to reach him on the phone.
sentences.zh: 最终，艾拉通过电话联系上了他。

sentences.en: I'll give it to my dad.
sentences.zh: 我要把它交给我爸爸。

sentences.en: From the first day that he called us to speak to us, that man has holding strong.
sentences.zh: 从他给我们打电话同我们通话的第一天起，那个男人就一直表现得很坚强。

sentences.en: Every time we call, he has the most positive energy, and so positive that he will see us, and things will go back to not normal,
sentences.zh: 每次我们打电话，他都充满最积极的能量，而且极其积极，坚信他会见到我们，事情会回到不正常的状态，

sentences.en: because I don't feel like anybody could really treat life as normal after the situation, but definitely better.
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得经历这种情况后没有人能真正把生活当作正常，但绝对会变好。

sentences.en: Isla's dad told her to hold strong, too.
sentences.zh: 艾拉的爸爸也叫她要坚强。

sentences.en: He said the detention center wasn't so bad.
sentences.zh: 他说拘留中心其实没那么糟。

sentences.en: He told her he'd gotten a job cleaning, which allowed more time outside of his cell.
sentences.zh: 他告诉她，他找了一份打扫卫生的工作，这让他有更多时间待在牢房外面。

sentences.en: He started a Bible study with a group of other detainees, and he was allowed visitors.
sentences.zh: 他和其他一群被拘留者一起开始了一项圣经学习班，而且他被允许探视。

sentences.en: I'm the only one eligible to visit because I'm over 18, and I was actually filling out the papers, and I was on the phone with him telling him when he called my mom,
sentences.zh: 我是唯一有资格去探视的人，因为我满18岁了，我当时其实正在填表格，我正在和他通电话，告诉他当我妈妈打电话来时，

sentences.en: I'm filling out the papers to come visit you.
sentences.zh: 我正在填表格去看望你。

sentences.en: I'm trying, like, because you have to send it through the mail.
sentences.zh: 我在努力，因为你必须通过邮件寄送。

sentences.en: It's a whole process, so I tried to do it as fast as possible.
sentences.zh: 这是一个完整的流程，所以我尽量以最快的速度完成。

sentences.en: And he told me, like, as much as I would love to see you guys so much,
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，尽管我非常非常想见到你们，

sentences.en: just don't come here, because this is not the person that I am.
sentences.zh: 但千万不要来这里，因为这不是真正的我。

sentences.en: And he was just like, it would hurt to see you get up from that chair and turn your back and have to leave.
sentences.zh: 他只是觉得，看着你从那把椅子上站起来，转身背对然后不得不离开，会让人很心痛。

sentences.en: That's when reality would hit.
sentences.zh: 那时现实才会真正重击心灵。

sentences.en: It's very hard to comprehend that, and it's very hard to imagine that.
sentences.zh: 这很难理解，也很难想象。

sentences.en: But as the days in custody turn into weeks, the two of them adapted to a new version of their relationship.
sentences.zh: 但随着在押的日子变成数周，他们两人适应了他们关系的一种新形式。

sentences.en: No visits, but they talk on the phone, a lot, as often as five times a day.
sentences.zh: 没有探视，但他们在电话里聊天，聊很多，一天最多可以打五次电话。

sentences.en: We open every conversation like he was here with us.
sentences.zh: 我们开始每一次对话，都好像他跟我们在一起一样。

sentences.en: Like, I'm walking into the house saying hi to him.
sentences.zh: 就像，我走进屋子向他打招呼。

sentences.en: Ben said, hi, Dad, how are you?
sentences.zh: 本说，嗨，爸爸，你好吗？

sentences.en: I missed you.
sentences.zh: 我想你了。

sentences.en: We continue lives how it is, like on the phone.
sentences.zh: 我们像往常一样继续生活，就像在电话里一样。

sentences.en: What are some of the updates that you give him on how life was going for you?
sentences.zh: 你向他汇报的生活进展有哪些呢？

sentences.en: I gave him updates on my grades.
sentences.zh: 我向他汇报了我的成绩。

sentences.en: I gave him updates on my finals.
sentences.zh: 我向他汇报了我的期末考试。

sentences.en: Well, I can't show to him my projects, since they're all, like, online-based, because they're all, like, floor plans, stuff like that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不能把我的项目展示给他看，因为它们基本上都是在线的，因为它们全都是平面图之类的东西。

sentences.en: But I, like, give him the visual analysis.
sentences.zh: 但我，会向他做视觉分析。

sentences.en: Inside the cell, time had stopped for Isla's dad.
sentences.zh: 在牢房里，对艾拉的爸爸来说，时间已经停止了。

sentences.en: For Isla, on the other hand, life went on, and her dad didn't want to miss out on it.
sentences.zh: 而另一方面，对于艾拉来说，生活仍在继续，而她爸爸不想错过这一切。

sentences.en: So my school requires me to do an internship.
sentences.zh: 所以我的学校要求我做实习。

sentences.en: Within that day that I literally got that interview, like, from the night before that I got a call to get the interview, as soon as he called, let him know.
sentences.zh: 就在我真正获得那个面试的那天，也就是我接到面试电话的前一天晚上，他一打电话来，我就让他知道了。

sentences.en: He's telling me, good luck on your interview.
sentences.zh: 他在对我说，祝你面试顺利。

sentences.en: My dad always says to be prepared.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸总是说要做好准备。

sentences.en: And be at least, well, my dad at his job, he was like, if you let him, he was an hour early.
sentences.zh: 并且至少，好吧，我爸爸在工作时，他是那种，如果你由着他，他会早到一小时的人。

sentences.en: So he would at least tell me to be at least 30 minutes early.
sentences.zh: 所以他至少会告诉我要提前至少30分钟到。

sentences.en: So I took that advice.
sentences.zh: 所以我采纳了那个建议。

sentences.en: I was 30 minutes early.
sentences.zh: 我提前了30分钟。

sentences.en: And on top of that, I already had everything printed.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，我已经把所有东西都打印好了。

sentences.en: I literally had it in a folder.
sentences.zh: 我真的把它放在一个文件夹里。

sentences.en: He was like, yep, that's how I like.
sentences.zh: 他说，对，这就是我喜欢的。

sentences.en: So as soon as she was ready to, like, give me the opportunity, I could just give her the folder, and I was automatically hired.
sentences.zh: 所以她准备给我这个机会时，我就可以直接把文件夹交给她，然后我就自动被录用了。

sentences.en: Oh, wow, amazing.
sentences.zh: 哦，哇，太棒了。

sentences.en: And then how did you share the news with him?
sentences.zh: 然后你是怎么把这个消息告诉他的？

sentences.en: I just, like, I couldn't hold it.
sentences.zh: 我只是，我按捺不住。

sentences.en: I literally was like, hi, Bansa, how are you?
sentences.zh: 我真的就说，嗨，本萨，你好吗？

sentences.en: He was like, great.
sentences.zh: 他说，很好。

sentences.en: Your mom said you had great news for me.
sentences.zh: 你妈妈说你有好消息要告诉我。

sentences.en: I was like, yep.
sentences.zh: 我说，是的。

sentences.en: And I told her, I was just like, I got the job.
sentences.zh: 然后我告诉她，我就说，我得到这份工作了。

sentences.en: I'm working at the company.
sentences.zh: 我在那家公司工作。

sentences.en: Explain the company to him.
sentences.zh: 向他解释了这家公司。

sentences.en: And he was like, look at you.
sentences.zh: 然后他说，看看你。

sentences.en: Like, I'm so proud of you.
sentences.zh: 就像，我为你感到骄傲。

sentences.en: He would always tell me, like, these are the things that keep me going.
sentences.zh: 他总是对我说，这些是让我坚持下去的事情。

sentences.en: You're going after your future.
sentences.zh: 你在追求你的未来。

sentences.en: You're creating a future for yourself.
sentences.zh: 你在为自己创造一个未来。

sentences.en: And I need you to continue to do that for me.
sentences.zh: 我需要你继续为我这样做。

sentences.en: These calls went on for two months.
sentences.zh: 这些电话持续了两个月。

sentences.en: And then in April, Isla learned of two major developments.
sentences.zh: 然后在4月，艾拉得知了两个重大进展。

sentences.en: First, ICE was going to enforce an order of removal against her dad, which meant he could be deported immediately.
sentences.zh: 首先，移民及海关执法局将对她父亲执行驱逐令，这意味着他可能会被立即驱逐出境。

sentences.en: Second, ICE was moving him over 1,600 miles to a notorious detention center in Louisiana, which had been investigated by the Department of Homeland Security for alleged abuses.
sentences.zh: 其次，移民及海关执法局将他转移到1600多英里外路易斯安那州的一个臭名昭著的拘留中心，该中心曾因涉嫌虐待而被国土安全部调查。

sentences.en: After he was transferred there.
sentences.zh: 在他被转到那里之后。

sentences.en: Can you hear me?
sentences.zh: 你能听到我说话吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I can.
sentences.zh: 是的，我能。

sentences.en: I gave her a call on a recent Sunday.
sentences.zh: 我在最近的一个周日给她打了个电话。

sentences.en: How was your Easter Sunday?
sentences.zh: 你的复活节周日过得怎么样？

sentences.en: Um, you know, it is fine.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道的，还行吧。

sentences.en: We're just missing our dad, so.
sentences.zh: 我们只是很想念我爸爸，所以。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Um, he got transferred to, um, Louisiana last night.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他昨晚被转到，嗯，路易斯安那州去了。

sentences.en: Isla says her dad's new detention center in Pine Prairie, Louisiana, is nothing like the one in Plymouth.
sentences.zh: 艾拉说她爸爸在路易斯安那州松树草原的新拘留中心跟普利茅斯的那个完全不一样。

sentences.en: It's quite literally a prison where people that actually committed real crimes would be in.
sentences.zh: 那简直就是一个关押真正犯下罪行的人的监狱。

sentences.en: Like, he's in a jail cell where it's just, like, ten times worse.
sentences.zh: 就像，他关在一间牢房里，情况要糟糕十倍。

sentences.en: Guards are completely strict.
sentences.zh: 警卫极其严格。

sentences.en: Like, there's no really sitting there conversating with them.
sentences.zh: 就像，根本没有坐在那里跟他们聊天的机会。

sentences.en: Like, there are guards.
sentences.zh: 到处都是警卫。

sentences.en: And he says that it's a mess in there.
sentences.zh: 他说里面一团糟。

sentences.en: It's just, like, very chaotic.
sentences.zh: 就像，非常混乱。

sentences.en: Everybody's everywhere.
sentences.zh: 所有人都到处都是。

sentences.en: Everybody's mixed.
sentences.zh: 所有人混杂在一起。

sentences.en: When Isla talks to her dad now, things feel different.
sentences.zh: 现在艾拉跟她爸爸说话时，感觉变得不一样了。

sentences.en: She senses that the brave face her dad had put on is starting to crack.
sentences.zh: 她感觉到她爸爸一直戴着的勇敢面具开始出现裂痕了。

sentences.en: He was very sincere this time on this call.
sentences.zh: 这次通电话时他非常真诚。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Like, it's not good.
sentences.zh: 就像，情况不太妙。

sentences.en: Usually he wouldn't really complain about Plymouth.
sentences.zh: 通常他不会真正抱怨普利茅斯。

sentences.en: But now, like, like my mom was saying right now to me, that, like, since it's starting to hit two months and reality is really knocking at our door,
sentences.zh: 但现在，就像我妈妈刚才对我说的那样，因为已经快满两个月了，现实真正敲响了我们的门，

sentences.en: especially with the deportation, now I feel like he's really being sincere of how he's truly feeling.
sentences.zh: 特别是面临驱逐出境，现在我觉得他真的很真诚地表达了他真实的感受。

sentences.en: Like, and I don't want to say he's in full panic, but he's really feeling it.
sentences.zh: 而且我不想说他完全陷入了恐慌，但他确实感受到了。

sentences.en: Even so, on the phone, like, I can hear himself let go.
sentences.zh: 即便如此，在电话里，我能听到他情绪的卸防。

sentences.en: I can hear his voice drop, and I can hear that, like, excitement that he would try to have low.
sentences.zh: 我能听到他的声音低沉下去，我能听到他一直极力保持的那种兴奋感低落了下来。

sentences.en: And this change in mood is starting to have an impact on Isla, too.
sentences.zh: 而这种情绪的变化也开始对艾拉产生影响。

sentences.en: It's like this feeling of, like, life keeps going, and life still feels normal, but there's something wrong.
sentences.zh: 这就好像是一种感觉，生活还在继续，生活依然感觉很正常，但有什么地方不对劲。

sentences.en: It's just all so real now.
sentences.zh: 这一切现在都太真实了。

sentences.en: Within these last days, I felt like my anxiety has been over the roof.
sentences.zh: 在过去的这些天里，我感觉我的焦虑情绪简直爆棚了。

sentences.en: It just feels like it's so hard to get through your day.
sentences.zh: 感觉度过这一天太难了。

sentences.en: It's so hard, like, because I can't believe it.
sentences.zh: 太难了，因为我简直不敢相信。

sentences.en: You cannot tell me they'll be taking my dad, and he will be in Brazil for the next, like,
sentences.zh: 你不能告诉我说他们会带走我爸爸，而他接下来会在巴西待上，比如，

sentences.en: 10 years up until we can reapply for him to come.
sentences.zh: 10年，直到我们能够重新申请让他回来。

sentences.en: Like, that does not cross my mind.
sentences.zh: 这种事我的脑海里根本无法想象。

sentences.en: Oh, man.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Would you ever consider moving to Brazil to be with your dad if it came to that?
sentences.zh: 如果真到了那一步，你有没有考虑过搬到巴西去陪你爸爸？

sentences.en: As much as I would love to stay here and be like, yeah, my family's going to reunite in Brazil, it can't be a plan.
sentences.zh: 尽管我很想留在这里然后说，对啊，我的家人将在巴西团聚，但这不能成为一个计划。

sentences.en: And it's also, it can't be a plan due to the fact that my parents have worked way too damn hard, too many years of their damn life to come here.
sentences.zh: 而且这也是因为，我的父母为了来到这里，付出了太多的辛劳，耗费了他们生命中太多的岁月，所以这绝对不能是一个计划。

sentences.en: I will be continuing college.
sentences.zh: 我会继续上大学。

sentences.en: And if anything, I will be continuing their success times that by 100.
sentences.zh: 而且如果有机会的话，我会将他们的成就扩大100倍。

sentences.en: I refuse to believe that they'll be throwing that away.
sentences.zh: 我拒绝相信他们会轻易放弃这一切。

sentences.en: And if I can even continue my dad's company to keep going and get other people to manage it, I will be continuing to making their name.
sentences.zh: 如果我甚至能让爸爸的公司继续运营下去，并让其他人来管理，我会继续延续他们的名声。

sentences.en: So Brazil was never in my plans.
sentences.zh: 所以巴西从来不在我的计划之中。

sentences.en: It's one thing to take my dad away from me.
